result_text:
Cancelled purchase orders are now left out of the per-rep purchase order count. `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, including a new one for this case).

- **Fix:** `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` had no status filter. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same condition the other per-rep and purchase-order queries use.
- **Test:** `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java` gets a `leavesOutCancelledPurchaseOrders` case that mirrors your example (Anna 2, Bob 1). The `purchaseOrder` helper gained a status overload so the existing calls are unchanged.

I didn't run the new test against the unfixed code to confirm it fails there. Nothing is committed.
